  208      """Keyed `serve_search` example child serving the ported tool surface."""
  209  
  210      def __init__(self, exe: Path, db: Path, workspace: Path, env: dict):
  211          self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
  212              [str(exe), str(db)],
  213              cwd=str(workspace),
  214              env=env,
  215              stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
  216              stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
  217              text=True,
  218          )
  219          self.port: int | None = None
  220          self.url: str | None = None
  221          self._output: list[str] = []
  222          self._reader = threading.Thread(target=self._read_output, daemon=True)
  223          self._reader.start()
  224  
  225      def _read_output(self) -> None:
  226          for line in self.proc.stdout:
  227              self._output.append(line)
  228              m = SERVE_ADDR_RE.search(line)
  229              if m and self.port is None:
  230                  self.port = int(m.group(1))
  231                  self.url = lifecycle.mcp_url(self.port)
  232  
  233      def wait_ready(self) -> bool:
  234          deadline = time.monotonic() + HEALTHZ_TIMEOUT_S
  235          while time.monotonic() < deadline:
  236              if self.proc.poll() is not None:
  237                  return False
  238              if self.port is not None and lifecycle.healthz_responds(
  239                  self.port, lifecycle.DEFAULT_HOST, timeout=2.0
  240              ):
  241                  return True
  242              time.sleep(0.25)
  243          return False
  244  
  245      def diagnostics(self) -> str:
  246          return "".join(self._output)[-2000:]
  247  
  248      def stop(self) -> None:
  249          if self.proc.poll() is None:
  250              self.proc.terminate()
  251              try:
  252                  self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
  253              except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  254                  self.proc.kill()
  255                  self.proc.wait(timeout=10)

  284  def _cairn_pack_fit(conn, arm, t):
  285      from cairn.dashboard.tokenizer import active_tokenizer_mode
  286      from cairn.okf import OKFBundle
  287      from cairn.pack import build_pack
  288  
  289      bundle = OKFBundle(t["knowledge_root"])
  290      result = build_pack(conn, bundle, _pack_question(t), _PACK_BUDGET_TOKENS)
  291      # One pack request counts as one call. The fitted item content is the
  292      # budget-bounded deliverable (the header only echoes the request), so it
  293      # is both the context cost and the fit substrate, and the per-call
  294      # result cap does not apply.
  295      arm.calls += 1
  296      content = "\n".join(item.text for item in result.items)
  297      arm.chars += len(content)
  298      targets = _fit_targets(t)
  299      hits = sum(1 for name in targets if name in content)
  300      return _FitResult(
  301          hits=hits, total=len(targets), tokenizer_mode=active_tokenizer_mode()
  302      )

  284  def _cairn_pack_fit(conn, arm, t):
  285      from cairn.dashboard.tokenizer import active_tokenizer_mode
  286      from cairn.okf import OKFBundle
  287      from cairn.pack import build_pack
  288  
  289      bundle = OKFBundle(t["knowledge_root"])
  290      result = build_pack(conn, bundle, _pack_question(t), _PACK_BUDGET_TOKENS)
  291      # One pack request counts as one call. The fitted item content is the
  292      # budget-bounded deliverable (the header only echoes the request), so it
  293      # is both the context cost and the fit substrate, and the per-call
  294      # result cap does not apply.
  295      arm.calls += 1
  296      content = "\n".join(item.text for item in result.items)
  297      arm.chars += len(content)
  298      targets = _fit_targets(t)
  299      hits = sum(1 for name in targets if name in content)
  300      return _FitResult(
  301          hits=hits, total=len(targets), tokenizer_mode=active_tokenizer_mode()
  302      )
